programme.desc: Moments after takeoff, Lisa's seatmate, Jackson, menacingly reveals the real reason he's on board: He is an operative in a plot to kill a rich and powerful businessman .... And Lisa is the key to its success.

programme.title: Dope

programme.title: Yakuza Wolf 2

programme.title: The Bodyguard

programme.title: Jay and Silent Bob Reboot

programme.title: The Thing Called Love

programme.title: The Net

programme.desc: Sidney Poitier and Rod Steiger (who won a Best Actor Oscar® for his performance) shine in this classic mystery-thriller that took home five Academy Awards®, including Best Picture and Best Adapted Screenplay. Lee Grant and Warren Oates also star.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible - Rogue Nation

programme.title: Mission: Impossible - Ghost Protocol
programme.desc: Agent Ethan Hunt and his elite team go underground after a bombing implicates them as terrorists. While trying to clear their name, the team uncovers a plot to start a nuclear war.

programme.title: Devon

programme.title: Joy Ride
programme.desc: When a psychotic trucker takes offense at the pranks pulled by a couple of college students, the young kids are sucked into a whirlpool of terror.

programme.desc: Lots of guys have second thoughts about marriage. Three hours before his wedding, Roland is having third, fourth and fifth thoughts. Good thing he’s got buddies Slim and Mike around to help.

programme.title: Don't Tell Mom the Babysitter's Dead (2024)

programme.title: Revenge of the Ninja

programme.title: Rage of Honor

programme.title: Black Eagle

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris

programme.desc: Sick of being second best to his little brother, Chris decides to enroll in karate classes.

programme.desc: Chris takes his father's playboy magazine to school, but he soon panics when it's stolen

programme.title: Naked Gun 33 1/3: The Final Insult

programme.desc: After an accident, a chauvenistic executive gains the ability to hear what women are really thinking.

programme.title: Secret Window
programme.desc: Academy Award® nominee Johnny Depp (2003 Best Actor, Pirates of the Caribbean: The Curse of the Black Pearl) gives his most riveting performance in this action/suspense thriller featuring a top-notch cast.

programme.title: Witness

programme.title: Good Will Hunting

programme.title: The Riot Act

programme.title: Billy the Kid

programme.title: Geronimo: An American Legend

programme.title: All the Pretty Horses

programme.title: Transformers: Age of Extinction

programme.title: Transformers

programme.title: Transformers: Revenge of the Fallen

programme.title: Airplane!

programme.title: Airplane II: The Sequel

programme.title: Hot in Cleveland

programme.title: Hot in Cleveland
programme.desc: On their shared birthday, Joy receives three proposals, Victoria's date has two noses, Melanie's has a sex surrogate, and Elka's is very surprising.
